column1: # sdk/MANIFEST.tsv -- every header in sdk/usr/include, and where it comes from.
# One row per header:   <path under usr/include>  TAB  <source>
#   <repo>:<path>   a file in apple-oss-distributions/<repo> at the tag pinned
#                   in sdk/SOURCES.tsv.  Redistributable; licence per SOURCES.
#                   a header that is not a blob upstream but is the OUTPUT of a
#                   generator upstream publishes.  scripts/sdk_stage.sh runs it.
#                   One row: sys/_posix_availability.h, whose generated form is
#   objc4:<path>    a file in vendor/objc4 (Apple's objc4 drop, APSL 2.0).
#   local           a clean-room header of ours, in sdk/local/.  It exists
#                   because the SDK copy has no published source (or the
#                   published source is a stale snapshot).  sdk/PROVENANCE.md
#                   says what each one omits versus Apple's.
# The set of 356 paths is the MEASURED dependency closure of everything this
# project compiles -- see docs/SDK_SURVEY.md §1.  It is a manifest and not a
# `cp -R` on purpose: whole upstream trees carry kernel-side headers with the
